segments.name: Call money
segments.dealing: Request for quote between named banks (or over the counter, reported within 15 minutes)
segments.counterparty: The other bank: unsecured, so each lender carries its borrower's credit risk, which is why RBI caps call borrowing
segments.settlement: Bilaterally through RTGS, during the day

segments.name: TREPS (tri-party repo)
segments.collateral: Government securities, held and allocated by CCIL as tri-party agent
segments.counterparty: CCIL, as central counterparty: each trade is novated to it
segments.settlement: Netted by CCIL with outright and market repo trades; funds settle at RBI, securities move between GILT accounts at CCIL

segments.name: Market repo
segments.collateral: Government securities, sold and bought back
segments.settlement: Netted by CCIL with outright trades, funds and securities together

data.model: Rates and volumes are the simulated day's: TREPS and market repo trade at WACR plus, and in proportion to call volume by, their medians over the last year of RBI's daily releases.

sources.claim: NDS-CALL is an electronic request-for-quote platform owned by RBI and managed by Clearcorp, a wholly owned subsidiary of CCIL. CROMS (market repo) and TREPS (tri-party repo) are Clearcorp's anonymous order-matching systems for dealing against G-secs.

Call money is settled bilaterally through RTGS, throughout the day. Market repo and TREPS are settled through CCIL, which acts as central counterparty, with multilateral netting of funds and securities.
sources.document: RBI, Report of the Working Group on Comprehensive Review of Trading and Settlement Timings of Markets Regulated by the Reserve Bank (draft)

sources.claim: TREPS trades flow from Clearcorp to CCIL, the tri-party agent, which novates them and nets them for funds settlement with outright and market repo trades. The borrower's securities move from its GILT account at CCIL to CCIL's settlement account, and on to the lender's once funds have settled at RBI.
sources.document: CCIL, Triparty Repo: Clearing and Settlement Procedure

sources.claim: NDS-CALL is the platform for executing and reporting call, notice and term money; deals done over the counter are reported on it within 15 minutes. Only banks and primary dealers may take part.
